// diagnostic

E0151

`{state}` is not a declared state of `{type}`.

What

`{state}` is not a declared state of `{type}`.

Why

Typestate: `{type}: struct { state { … } }` defines the valid state labels; a name not in that set is likely a typo — a phantom state no transition can reach.

Fix

Correct the spelling, or add `{state}` inside `{type}: struct { state { … } }`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0151: tests/ui/typestate/enum_state_list_names_only_cases.stderr.

Error [jet.TypestateUnknownState]: `Ajar` is not a case of `Door`
  --> tests/ui/typestate/enum_state_list_names_only_cases.jet:7:9
    |
  7 |         Ajar
    |         ^^^^
 Why: The states of an enum are its cases, so a state list in `Door: enum` names only cases
 Fix: Add `Ajar` as a case of `Door`, or correct the spelling
